title.narrative: Strategic Workforce Planning for Teachers in Ireland

description.narrative: Ireland is currently experiencing an increased overall demand for teachers as well as more difficulties to retain those who join the profession. While different measures have been taken to tackle teacher shortages, Ireland lacks both the evidence on the complex factors affecting teacher supply, and a consensus among stakeholders on a national strategy for effective teacher workforce planning. The project will respond to these needs, and it will generate evidence on the multiplicity of factors affecting teacher supply in Ireland. This includes demographic changes, teacher professional development, governance reforms, international teacher mobility, labour market trends and teacher allocation, among others. More specifically, the project will bring together stakeholders for a comprehensive review of the factors exacerbating teacher shortages to develop a set of actionable recommendations, accompanied by a roadmap, for effective workforce planning. This process will contribute to a consensus among different actors on a national strategy for a sustainable teaching profession. The technical support will be particularly beneficial in boosting Ireland’s capacity to achieve a coordinated action with sustainable results. At a strategic level, the project is expected to lead to change in polices relating to teacher workforce planning in Ireland.
